snippet.title: Dash Dot Die // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3738450/Dash_Dot_Die

Dash Dot Die is a first-person Morse puzzle game set in a maze of forgotten rooms, hallways, and airducts. Your past has caught up with you. Someone is determined to make you suffer just as they once did. Trapped in their twisted game, you must endure the same fate and overcome every challenge.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Iron Interactive Games
📚 Publisher: Iron Interactive Games
📅 Release Date: Sep 22, 2026 
🎯 Genre: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie

The developers describe the content like this:
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: General Mature Content
